name: hcapp_getPaymentReport
description: Returns a combined payment report for an event. The single result set is a UNION of four segments: (1) actual payment records, (2) synthetic 'not paid' rows for attendees without payments, (3) aggregate totals by payment type (paymentType+100), and (4) a count of unpaid hashers (paymentType=101). SET NOCOUNT ON is misplaced (after first error checks).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to report on. Default null-UUID. Null or null-UUID causes all UNION segments to return empty (WHERE @eventId IS NOT NULL guards).

rowsets.name: PaymentReport
rowsets.description: UNION of 4 segments — caller must use paymentType to determine row category. paymentType 1-8=normal payments; 1=not paid (synthetic); 101+=aggregate rows (paymentType+100 from original).

columns.name: userIdWhoPaid
columns.description: Hasher.id of the user who paid (or should pay).

columns.name: paymentId
columns.description: Payment.id. NULL for not-paid and aggregate rows.

columns.name: paidBy
columns.description: Display name of payer. 'not used' for aggregate rows.

columns.name: paidTo
columns.description: Display name of payment receiver. 'none' for not-paid rows.

columns.name: paymentType
columns.description: Payment type code. Values 1-8 are actual payments; 101+ are aggregate summary rows (original type + 100).

columns.name: paymentReference
columns.description: Payment reference code. For aggregate rows: count of payments or @hashersNotPaidCount.

columns.name: creditRemaining
columns.description: Credit available from kennel credit pool.

columns.name: currencySymbol
columns.description: Currency symbol from Country table. Empty string for aggregate rows.

columns.name: digitsAfterDecimal
columns.description: Currency decimal places. 0 for aggregate rows.

codeSmells.issue: Aggregate sentinel: paymentType+100 — fragile mixed data in single column
codeSmells.detail: Aggregate summary rows have paymentType = originalType + 100 (e.g., type 3 → 103). Callers must check paymentType >= 101 to detect aggregate rows. This mixes data and metadata in a single column.

codeSmells.issue: SET NOCOUNT ON placed after the first error block
codeSmells.detail: The first IF error block fires before SET NOCOUNT ON is reached, meaning the error SELECT may be accompanied by row-count messages.

codeSmells.issue: paymentDate and cancelledDate cast to DATETIME — timezone stripped
codeSmells.detail: Payment.PaidDate and CancelledDate are CAST to DATETIME, losing any timezone offset.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change paymentType codes or the +100 aggregate convention without updating all callers
